name: @horsie/types
description: TypeScript types generated from horsie's fluorite protocol schemas. Requires the `fluorite` CLI on PATH (cargo install fluorite_codegen).

scripts.generate-types: fluorite clean -o src/generated && fluorite ts -i ../../crates/models/fluorite/agent.fl ../../crates/models/fluorite/hooks.fl ../../crates/models/fluorite/runtime.fl ../../crates/models/fluorite/capabilities.fl ../../crates/models/fluorite/session.fl ../../crates/models/fluorite/session_api.fl ../../crates/models/fluorite/settings.fl ../../crates/models/fluorite/auth.fl ../../crates/models/fluorite/agents.fl ../../crates/models/fluorite/routines.fl ../../crates/models/fluorite/executor.fl ../../crates/models/fluorite/environments.fl ../../crates/models/fluorite/workflow.fl -o src/generated
